Stage: Evidence Build

Goals:
- narrow the differential using high-yield questions and high-yield tests;
- prioritize benchmark-supported tests that change the ranking of the top diagnoses;
- look for the single decisive discriminator, not a pile of normal studies.

Failure modes to avoid:
- serial low-yield tests that return normal readings;
- repeating questions that do not change management;
- drifting into a specialty lane without enough evidence.
